content_source: Public channel listing 2026-09-23 + Studio KPIs (Earn 35 through Sep 18). CTR / per-video hours pending Studio Content tab.
recs: YPP gate is qualified hours (35 / 4,000), not subs. Keep the 7pm–3am live → public VOD path; that is what moved Analytics 7d to 378 hours.
Long mixes beat new 3-minute Official Videos. Position English Mix + Latin Mix in the Mixes playlist and end-screen every new single into a mix.

Among singles, Que Vuelvan los Clásicos and Don't Let It Stop are the ones people actually open. Match that thumb/title pattern on the next salsa/classics cut before another 90s R&B single with 4–7 views.
Earn Shorts views are 3.4K of 10M. Do not treat Shorts as the YPP plan. Use Shorts only as a funnel into the live and the long mixes.
Analytics hours ≠ Earn hours. Log the Earn meter daily so a live night is not mistaken for YPP progress.
